name: tactus-infoview
description: Inline Lean goal state at the cursor for Tactus .rs proofs — a thin client over tactus-lsp.

tactus.serverPath.description: Path to the tactus-lsp binary (on PATH, or an absolute path to the built binary).

tactus.sidecarPath.description: Path to sourcemap.json (the `verus --emit-lean` sidecar). If empty, auto-discovers the first `**/tactus-lean/*/sourcemap.json` in the workspace.

tactus.leanProject.description: Path to the Tactus lean-project dir (sets TACTUS_LEAN_PROJECT so tactus-lsp can resolve LEAN_PATH via `lake env`). Needs `lake` on PATH; prefer tactus.leanPath instead if you have the value.

tactus.leanPath.description: The LEAN_PATH value (colon-separated olean dirs), passed directly so tactus-lsp does NOT need to run `lake`. Get it with `lake env printenv LEAN_PATH` in the lean-project. Recommended — GUI-launched VS Code usually can't find `lake`.

tactus.toolchainBin.description: Directory containing the `lean` (and `lake`) binaries; prepended to PATH for the spawned server so it can launch `lean --server`. Required when VS Code's environment lacks the toolchain on PATH (e.g. GUI-launched). Find it with `dirname $(which lean)`.
